title: Expose a stable non-secret copilot-api translation contract and build provenance marker on the private /v1/models response so Tesseragateway can record the exact proxy contract used by client compatibility canaries. Keep catalog data backward-compatible; distinguish semantic contract version from package/build revision; never expose GitHub or Copilot tokens, account identity, paths, or mutable runtime counters; add deterministic route tests and document when each marker changes.
